observations.why: Mandating a signed manifest before deployment appeals to security/stability (conservation) and quality-of-craft control (competence).

evidence.quote: that is the whole reason for the gate

observations.why: Citing past unsigned artifacts as justification for the gate frames the gate as protective security, a conservation appeal.
Declaring a required signed manifest performs the conservation move (security gate) and the competence move (craft verification).
Extending the gate's scope to both staging and production appeals to uniform security coverage, a conservation value.
